name: Latent Sparse Attention claims large prefill speedups at 10M-token context
title: Latent Sparse Attention claims large prefill speedups at 10M-token context
summary: The LSA paper clusters similar tokens into a searchable hierarchy so sparse attention can find relevant tokens without scanning the whole context. At 10M tokens it reports one attention layer 22.7x faster in prefill and 4.6x faster in decode than GLM-5.3-Flash's sparse attention, at similar accuracy.
